subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery with these field names and permission semantics?
rationale: The patch is additive, but once released the manifest fields become plugin-author API surface and the metadata is intended to inform host permission binding around Accessibility and Screen Recording.

options.title: Accept after docs and owner confirmation
options.body: Regenerate the docs map, resolve the current-main conflicts, and confirm the metadata shape and permission semantics before merge.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow the fields, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before freezing the public plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep this PR draft until the macOS host discovery and trust boundary are settled enough to publish the manifest surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after docs and owner confirmation
